newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread off on profit-taking after results.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread off on profit-taking after results.

text.p: Shares in Whitbread were lower on Wednesday amid profit-taking after the group posted a 14 percent increase in first-half profits on Tuesday.
The shares were down 10p at 726-1/2p in volume of 3-1/2 million shares by 1144 GMT.
"The stock just got overbought," said one dealer. "It had a good run up ahead of the figures and now people are taking profits."
Whitbread shares put on over four percent in the two weeks prior to the group's results, which topped most analysts expectations.
The shares jumped immediately after Tuesday's results but finished 4p lower on the day as profit-taking and switching set in.

Others in the brewing sector, which were said to be benefiting from switching on Tuesday, were generally weaker today. Bass was down 3-1/2p to 785p, Greenalls had lost 2p to 588p and Scottish & Newcastle was off 1/2p at 648p.
